main_measure.name: mean excess 5-bar return after forecast >= 10 (vs coin mean)
main_measure.threshold: positive with t >= 2 confirms; negative with t <= -2 rejects; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: slope of excess 5-bar return on forecast, active bars, non-overlapping

decided_by: The t-statistic is between -2 and 2 (inconclusive rule).
reading: Situation checked on the 'regime' column (detector components not recorded) plus ret20 > 0 where recorded; cases and the coin's mean 5-bar return both use the non-overlapping grid (positions 0,5,10,... of each window) pooled over all windows; the supporting check is reported but does not change the status.
